swing_ideas.text: Cup and handle-esque breakout starting over the big bad 100 level. First inflection point target at 112, and then 134. In the right sector, just a matter of if price wants to cooperate with the breakout pattern. Nice cluster of moving average support below.

Bull flag holding over the prior resistance highs around 47. Looking for better breaks over 49.70 for moves into the "scene of the crime" breakdown at 51.75 and then the high at 53.4. Not interested if Wednesday's low breaks.

Bull flag breaking out on Friday. As long as price can stay over 195.5, looking for continuation up towards the ATH target at 220.60. Close watch if 195.5 fails, and not interested if price starts accepting below the daily 20 SMA (orange).
